definition: I. עָדָה verb pass on, advance (Arabic ( ) pass by , also run = Ethiopic pass by ; Aramaic עדי go along, go by (often for Hebrew עָבַר , Aph`el remove ; Syriac pass by, come , with fall upon ); — Qal Perfect 3 masculine singular עָדָה Job 28:8 the fierce lion hath not advanced upon it (that is, the way). Hiph`il Participle מַעֲדֶה בֶּגֶד Prov 25:20 removing a garment (compare Prov 38:19 ᵑ7 , Jonah 3:6 Hebrew and ᵑ7 ).
